title: Reminders
empty: No reminders yet. I will remind you 3 days before, 1 day before and on the due day.
loadError: Reminders could not be loaded. Check that the server is running, then try again.
unavailable: Reminders are paused for this vault. Restart Second Brain to turn them back on.
dismissAllBody: They leave this list. The deadlines stay on Today.
dismissFailed: The reminder could not be dismissed. Check that the server is running, then try again.

hint.notAsked: The browser may not show notifications yet, so reminders appear in this list. To turn them on, open Settings, Reminders, and click “Allow browser notifications”.
hint.denied: The browser blocks notifications from the app, so reminders only appear in this list. To turn them on, click the lock icon next to the address, find Notifications and choose Allow.
hint.unsupported: This browser does not show notifications, so reminders appear in this list.
